headline: Council holds fuel tax rate hearing; no one indicated a desire to testify

meeting.body: Maui County Council Notice of Public Hearing
meeting.summary: The Council opened testimony on Resolution 2663, which relates to adopting fuel tax rates for the County of Maui. The proposed rates would take effect July 1, 2026. Six members were present, three were excused, and the meeting adjourned.
